title: Tachyon flamegraph times use the wrong units

body_preview: Tachyon flamegraphs report times that depend on the sampling rate.  For example, a function that sleeps for 400 ms is shown as 0.40 ms at 1 kHz and 0.04 ms at 100 Hz. title: `get_method_signature_hook` is not invoked for `super().method(...)` calls
author: adamtheturtle
body_preview: The method signature plugin hooks run for normal method calls (`obj.method(...)`) but not for `super().method(...)`, even though both resolve to a method and are then checked as calls.  Plugins that rewrite method signatures therefore cannot enforce the same behavior on `super()` call sites without a separate, hand-rolled checker.
